verdict.rationale: Gitea's own docs say it tracks requirements, features and bugs as issues. They name labels and assignments explicitly, plus milestones, due dates and dependencies, so every element of the story is covered. Missing for 10: in-depth first-party documentation of the label and assignee workflows (the evidence is overview-level marketing copy), and independent or hands-on corroboration of issue tracking.

support.subject: As a developer, I can track bugs, features, and requirements as issues with labels and assignees

citations.quote: Gitea tracks project requirements, features, and bugs through columns and issues. Issues support features like branches, tags, milestones, assignments, time tracking, due dates, dependencies, and more.
Efficiently manage requirements, features, and bugs through issue tasks, labels, and kanban boards.
